{{Quote|If into the security recordings you go, only pain you will find."<br />"I must know the truth, Master.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda at the Jedi Temple|<ref name="Rots" />}}
Immediately following [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which saw the mass execution of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], surviving [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] conducted an '''infiltration''' of the fallen [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The temple had been [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attacked]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Kenobi's former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who had recently succumbed to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] and taken the name [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader. Except Yoda, Kenobi was unaware of Skywalker's fall or the cause of Order 66, and planned to return to the temple to investigate, as well as shut down an emergency [[Jedi beacon/Legends|beacon]] that had been activated by Vader that recalled Jedi back to the Temple and into a trap.

At the Temple, occupied by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Kenobi and Yoda encountered and fought [[Decoy Squad Five]], a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] whose members had [[Disguised Clone Trooper/Legends|disguised themselves as Jedi]] to lure any stragglers into a trap. They fought more clones at a surface entrance and continued to face different types of clone troopers on their way up to the [[Jedi Temple central security station/Legends|security station]]. On their way they discovered the [[Death/Legends|corpses]] of their Jedi brethren and noticed that several had been killed by [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strikes, but had little time to mourn as they hid from the thousands of clone troopers at the Temple.

After reaching the security station Kenobi fought a group of [[clone assassin]]s posted there by Vader and deactivated the beacon, after which the younger Jedi examined the security [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] to discover who had invaded the Temple. To his horror, Kenobi discovered Skywalker's betrayal with a hologram of him personally leading the attack on the temple. With their knowledge, Kenobi and Yoda set out to destroy the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] perpetrators of the Jedi massacre, with Yoda [[Skirmish in the Senate|fighting]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on Coruscant, while Kenobi confronted his former apprentice on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].

==Prelude==
===The Revenge of the Sith===
{{Quote|First, I want you to go to the Jedi Temple. We will catch them off balance. Do what must be done, Lord Vader. Do not hesitate; show no mercy.|Darth Sidious to his new apprentice Darth Vader|<ref name="Rots" />|audio=ShowNoMercy-RevengeOfTheSith.flac}}
Over centuries the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] facilitated the destruction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in secret, with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] becoming [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to fulfill that purpose.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Sidious orchestrated the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic&mdash;in which he served as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in his public identity as Palpatine&mdash;and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to bring about the destruction of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] secretly arranged an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to serve under the Jedi in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Rots" /> As the war drew to a close in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Palpatine revealed his true affiliation to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] prophesied to be the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] who would bring balance to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Skywalker informed [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] member [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] of Palpatine's [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] loyalty, leading the latter to [[Showdown on Coruscant|confront]] the Chancellor in his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|suite]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Rots" />

[[File:End_Days.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Darth Sidious executed Order 66 to annihilate the Jedi.]]
However, in fear of precognitive [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] he had seen of the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], Skywalker, believing that Palpatine had the power to help him save her life, intervened just as Windu planned to execute Palpatine, killing the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and pledging to become the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. In his first act as the newly christened [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, on Palpatine's orders he [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attacked]] the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and planned to exterminate every Jedi there. Concurrently, Palpatine enacted [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]],<ref name="Rots" /> a contingency plan which commanded the clone troopers to turn against their Jedi officers with lethal force,<ref name="Commando">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> that was enforced by secret [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chips]] implanted in their brains.<ref name="TCW|Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref> Across the galaxy the Jedi fell in battle to the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster-fire]] of their once loyal comrades, but not all were eliminated. Skywalker's [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] narrowly survived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], and on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] the deaths, was able to decapitate his would-be [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].<ref name="Rots" />

===Ruin of the Jedi===
{{Dialogue|Kenobi|Have we had any contact from the Temple?|Yoda|Received a coded retreat message, we have.|Organa|It requests all Jedi to return to the Temple. It says the war is over.|Kenobi|Well then we must go back, if there are any stragglers they will fall into the trap and be killed.|Yoda|Suggest dismantling the coded signal, do you?|Kenobi|Yes Master, there is too much at stake.|Yoda|I agree, and a little more knowledge might light our way.|attr=Obi-Wan Kenobi, Bail Organa, and Yoda plan the mission|src=<ref name="Rots" />}}
[[File:FlamingTemple.png|thumb|right|300px|The Jedi Temple was brought to ruin by Darth Vader.]]
Vader followed the orders of his new [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], leading thousands of [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] into the Temple and killing the Jedi there, including Master [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] and many [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]].<ref name="Rots novel" /> Once the clones were able to breach the [[Jedi Temple central security station/Legends|beacon control room]] at the Temple summit, Vader was able to use his access code to activate<ref name="Rots game home console" /> the [[Return-to-Coruscant]] code<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> recalling any Jedi to Coruscant immediately, and ordered several [[clone assassin]]s, who fought with wrist-mounted [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], to guard it with their lives.<ref name="Rots game home console" /> Clones were also stationed outside the Temple in [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi apparel]] to lure any surivors in.<ref name="Rots junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' junior novelization]]</ref> On the orders of Sidious, Vader then [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|traveled]] to the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to eliminate the members of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] and end the Clone Wars. Kenobi and Yoda were able to escape the warzones they had been attacked on and were collected by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], a Jedi supporter who witnessed the massacre at the temple firsthand. Aboard Organa's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']], Kenobi mourned the loss of his many friends, including Skywalker, whose death he incorrectly presumed, but Yoda urged him to focus on his responsibilities as a Jedi.<ref name="Rots novel" />

The Jedi realized the beacon was activated as a trap, and arranged to return to Coruscant to deactivate it to save any other survivors. Yoda also realized the need to understand how the Jedi had been betrayed.<ref name="Rots" /> Kenobi was discussing how Yoda could fit on his lap in the single-[[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of his stolen [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|Belbullab-22 starfighter]] [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']] when Organa was summoned back to Coruscant by Republic [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] for an emergency [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] session, where Palpatine would [[Declaration of a New Order|declare]] the reorganization of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The senator offered to escort the Jedi on his way. The Jedi and Organa arrived at the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of the Senate, where Kenobi [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]] a [[Unidentified Senate Guard (mind trick)|Senate Guard]] who was enthusiastic to [[Prisoner/Legends|arrest]] the Jedi into thinking that their presence was not a problem. Organa entered the Chamber while Kenobi and Yoda departed for the Jedi Temple.<ref name="Rots novel" />

==The mission==
===The incursion===
{{Quote|Master, I fear for Anakin."<br />"Hmm, clouded is his fate, concerned for him, I am.|Kenobi and Yoda on their way inside the temple|<ref name="Rots game portable" />}}
[[File:Pg3_saber_bg.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Yoda cutting down clone troopers]]
In the [[Standard day/Legends|daytime]], at a low level of the Temple onced used as a delivery point for supplies, Kenobi and Yoda encountered [[Decoy Squad Five]], an eight-man [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of clone troopers [[Disguised Clone Trooper/Legends|disguised as Jedi]]. Kenobi adopted the hunched stance and mannerisms of a tramp while holding Yoda in his [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. He offered his ancient companion as a Jedi infant to the clones, whose [[Unidentified clone trooper sergeant (Decoy Squad Five)|sergeant]] was skeptical and asked how it could be verified. Yoda responded by igniting his [[Yoda's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and Kenobi resumed his more dignified [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] accent and offered Decoy Squad Five a chance to surrender. The clones refused and were dispatched by the Jedi in six [[Standard second|seconds]].<ref name="Rots novel" />

At a surface entrance to the temple both Jedi took on a group of clones, deflecting blaster-fire with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and using the Force. Yoda [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] threw one clone trooper into two of his brothers, and killed another by impaling him with a thrown lightsaber. The Grand Master jumped onto that clone before leaping into further action.<ref name="Rots" /> Inside the Temple thousands of clone troopers were present to tally the clone and Jedi dead against official records. In one room of the Temple Kenobi and Yoda fought a large group of clones, also leaping up to a ledge to take down several [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone snipers]]. Another group of clones heard the Jedi approaching and detonated a large pillar, unwittingly giving the Jedi access to the ledge they were on. The Jedi continued fighting more clones, including [[clone blaze trooper]]s. Both became aware of the attention they were drawing, so Yoda suggested that the two split up. Kenobi fought more blaze troopers and other clones and was nearly killed by a [[Heavy weapons clone trooper/Legends|heavy gunner]] he had not noticed.<ref name="Rots game home console" />

===Continued battle===
{{Quote|A peculiar skill you have, Master Obi-Wan, of finding trouble.|Yoda|<ref name="Rots game portable" />}}
Yoda was surrounded by an overwhelming<ref name="Rots game Prima">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> wave of clone troopers, including blaze troopers and assassins, but the diminutive Jedi was able to defeat them all. He returned to help Kenobi, lifting the heavy gunner up with the Force so his weapon fired into the roof instead. Kenobi had to jump out of the way to avoid being crushed by the ensuing rubble, and Yoda joked that the younger Jedi was always finding himself in trouble. The two fought several clones together and both had to lift a large piece of rubble out of their path. In a hallway leading to the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] Kenobi had to repel [[Autoturret/Legends|turret]] fire while Yoda ran ahead to deactivate the weapons. Inside the library the Jedi found the body of [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]], the [[Jedi librarian/Legends|Jedi librarian]] who had been killed by Vader, and mourned their losses. While fighting more clones in the archives,<ref name="Rots game home console" /> including a [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Jedi Temple)|clone trooper commander]],<ref name="Rots game portable" /> the Temple's lockdown protocol was activated, shielding the exits. Kenobi cut open a wall panel to break the shield, also cutting through the door with his lightsaber. The two Jedi proceeded to a significantly damaged passageway where the walls were exposed to the outdoors. Several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|Low Altitude Assault Transports]] began firing on the Jedi, but were destroyed by Kenobi, who used an anti-aircraft cannon to block their missiles and destroy them.<ref name="Rots game home console" />

[[Clone trooper officer/Legends|Clone officers]] became concerned when some five-man surveillance squads began disappearing only for their corpses to appear stuffed inside closets. Some clones also beame concerned that the Temple was haunted through unexplained noises and movement in their peripheral vision.<ref name="Rots novel" /> Kenobi and Yoda found it easy to hide from the clones, having years of experience navigating the Temple's enormous passageways and rooms compared to the clones' single day.<ref name="Rots junior novel" /> Inside the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]] one clone in a cleanup squad noticed movement behind a stand of [[Hylaian marsh bamboo]] and led his comrades in pursuit. However, that movement was a diversion from the Jedi, who could now enter the room unimpeded.<ref name="Rots novel" />

===Discovering the truth===
{{Quote|I have recalibrated the code warning all surviving Jedi to stay away"<br />"For the clones to discover the recalibration, a long time it will take.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda|<ref name="Rots" />}}
[[File:Shock.png|thumb|right|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi was horrified to learn that his friend Anakin Skywalker had fallen to the dark side.]]
On a large bridge<ref name="Rots" /> inside the entrance hall<ref name="Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Kenobi and Yoda discovered the corpses of a group of younglings, at which the former immediately expressed his horror. Yoda observed that one male [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] had not been killed by blaster-fire, but by a [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Kenobi questioned who could have been responsible.<ref name="Rots" /> The two Jedi also encountered more bodies wounded by saber strikes. They reached the beacon room late at night, having spent the whole day slowly sneaking through the Temple,<ref name="Rots junior novel" /> and there they were ambushed by the clone assassins posted there by Vader, but Kenobi was able to defeat them.<ref name="Rots game home console" /> He recalibrated the emergency beacon through the force, switching the outgoing message from a request to come home to a warning to hide,<ref name="Rots novel" /> rather than simply deactivating the beacon.<ref name="Rots junior novel" /> Yoda observed that the clones would not discover the alteration for some time,<ref name="Rots" /> and insisted that the Jedi leave quickly to avoid detection, knowing the pain finding answers would cause, but Kenobi insisted on viewing security footage to discover the perpetrator of the attack on the Temple despite Yoda cautioning him not to for fear of discovering Skywalker's fall to the dark side.<ref name="Rots novel" />

Kenobi activated a security [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of the fight that had taken place between Skywalker and Drallig, witnessing him killing the Jedi Master along with many other younglings. He also witnessed Skywalker kneeling before Palpatine, realizing his new Sith allegiance and new identity as Darth Vader. Yoda proposed that the two Jedi destroy the Sith, and Kenobi offered to face Palpatine, unwilling to fight his former apprentice, who was like a brother to him. Yoda refused, believing Kenobi wasn't strong enough and that Anakin was no longer the boy trained by Kenobi but consumed by Darth Vader. Kenobi was unsure how he could find Skywalker, but Yoda insisted that he could find a way.<ref name="Rots" />

==Aftermath==
===Duels of Fate===
{{Quote|I have seen a security hologram of him killing younglings.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Rots" />}}
[[File:LightsaberCSWE.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Obi-Wan was forced to duel Anakin for his fall to the dark side.]]
Kenobi used a [[DC0052 speeder]] to travel to [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|Padmé Amidala's apartment]], hoping Skywalker's close friend and secret wife would know his location. Amidala found Kenobi's claim that Skywalker had fallen to the dark side and murdered younglings impossible to believe, and refused to reveal his location. However, filled with concern, Amidala traveled to the [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]] to confront her husband, with Kenobi stowing away on her [[J-type Naboo star skiff|ship]].<ref name="Rots" /> Prior to landing, Kenobi contacted Yoda by a comlink, with the Jedi wishing for positive outcomes on their respective missions.<ref name="Rots novel" /> On Mustafar, Amidala asked Skywalker about his actions and the new Sith denied them as a ploy by Kenobi to drive them apart. Amidala was relieved but grew more concerned when Vader expressed a desire for power and dominion over the galaxy, realizing that her husband had changed. When Kenobi emerged from Amidala's ship, Vader believed his wife had betrayed him and planned to kill him, using the Force to choke her in anger.<ref name="Rots" />

Kenobi and Vader [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|fought]], while Yoda simultaneously [[Skirmish in the Senate|battled]] Sidious in the Grand Convocation Chamber. The Grand Master lost his fight, retreating with the help of Organa. Kenobi left Vader for dead on the [[Magma/Legends|molten]] surface of Mustafar, but the Sith's Master found him and provided medical assistance on Coruscant to preserve his life. Kenobi took Amidala to [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]], where she gave birth to the twins [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and expressed belief that there was still good in Vader before she died from the loss of will to live.<ref name="Rots" /> Kenobi took Luke into hiding to Anakin's [[Lars family/Legends|relatives]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], watching over Luke to train the boy to become a Jedi when the time was right, believing that Luke would achieve what his father could not.<ref name="Desperate">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]''</ref> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Reader's">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]'' around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> Kenobi met with the former Jedi [[Ferus Olin]] and mentioned his mission to reset the beacon, but expressed doubt that any other Jedi had survived.<ref name="Desperate" />

===Saved by the beacon===
{{Quote|What is it, Roan? What?<br />"Another coded burst from the beacon,"<br />"Same order?"<br />"The opposite. All Jedi are ordered to avoid Coruscant at all costs. We're to abandon whatever missions we're involved in, and go into hiding.|Bol Chatak and Roan Shyrne receiving the new transmission from the Jedi Temple|<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
[[File:JediTemplePublicEntrance-Republic80.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A rally at the Temple was attended by Jedi who either missed or ignored the recalibrated beacon.]]
Several Jedi ignored the altered transmission and anonymously attended a rally at the Temple entrance, where clones were burning a large pile of corpses and wreckage from Operation: Knightfall. Master [[Kai Hudorra]] and his Padawan [[Noirah Na]] attended only because they had discarded their [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] and were unaware that the order to return to Coruscant had even been issued. One [[Unidentified Human Jedi (Jedi Temple)|Jedi]] identified his allegiance to the crowd and demanded that his hidden brethren join him in fighting back, but the present Jedi, including Hudorra, Na, [[Dass Jennir]], [[Shadday Potkin/Legends|Shadday Potkin]], and [[Koffi Arana]], refused, so the Jedi calling for action was killed on the Temple's steps and the rally was ended.<ref name="Republic">[[Republic 80|''Republic'' 80]]</ref>

Master [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]] was in his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] when Order 66 was given and began flying towards Coruscant in response to the Return-to-Coruscant beacon. After the infiltration changed the message Choi abandoned his vessel on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] and hid there until he was discovered by [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]].<ref name="Purge">[[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']]</ref> On the planet [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] in the Outer Rim, a group of Order 66 survivors; [[Roan Shryne]], [[Bol Chatak]], and [[Olee Starstone]], received the initial duplicitous transmission from the Temple through a beacon transceiver and made plans to steal a ship to return to Coruscant. Just as the Jedi trio found an appropriate ship to steal, the new trasmission came through, warning them to go into hiding. However, they still prepared to capture the ship to escape the occupied world, but were surrounded by clone troopers and [[Prisoner/Legends|captured]]. Chatak was killed by Vader in captivity on Murkhana, while Shyrne and Starstone focused on gathering a group of Jedi together to battle the new Galactic Empire, contrary to Yoda and Kenobi's intentions with the transmission.<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> Following the defeat of the Empire and formation of the New Republic, the New Jedi Order's Temple would be located on Yavin IV under the tutelage of Luke, the New Grand Master of the Jedi Order.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Dialogue|Disguised clone|Master Yoda, thank goodness you're safe. We've recaptured the Temple but we expect another clone attack at any moment.|Yoda|Hmm, quickly then.|Kenobi|You clones make terrible Jedi.|attr=The deleted scene "Imposters at the Jedi Temple"|src=<ref name="Rots" />}}
[[File:Clone_in_Jedi_disguise.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Clones disguised as Jedi were originally going to appear in ''Revenge of the Sith''.]]
Kenobi and Yoda's discovery of Skywalker's crimes within the Jedi Temple was described in the first draft of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], written by [[George Lucas]]. The scenes of Yoda fighting clones and the two Jedi finding the bodies of younglings were filmed on [[August 18]], [[2003]].<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Originally Kenobi and Yoda encountered clones wearing Jedi robes at the entrance to the temple, with the two immediately seeing through the ruse and cutting them down, but in postproduction the scene was deleted, and the standard clone trooper armor was edited over the robes for a short action sequence. The deleted scene was included in bonus discs of the DVD and Blu-ray releases of ''Revenge of the Sith''.<ref name="Rots" />

Matthew Stover's [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] of the film portrays the events in the Temple with some differences. Kenobi and Yoda discover the bodies of Drallig and several younglings in the Room of a Thousand Fountains rather than on a bridge, and it is Drallig's body that Yoda observes a lightsaber wound in,<ref name="Rots novel" /> instead of a Padawans.<ref name="Rots" /> Both the novel<ref name="Rots novel" /> and the [[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 4|comic]] portray Kenobi falling down in grief after observing Anakin's dark deeds,<ref name="Rots 4">[[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 4|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> which does not occur in the film.<ref name="Rots" />

The [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|home console video game adaptation]] of ''Revenge of the Sith'' portrays the infiltration with significantly more combat than the other versions, with the player controlling Kenobi in the level "Aftermath in the Temple", and fighting a wave of clones as Yoda in the bonus mission "Size Matters Not." The video game portrays Kenobi and Yoda as fighting their way through to the summit of the temple, where the security station is located,<ref name="Rots game home console" /> but the 2005 reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] places the security station at the base of the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]].<ref name="Locations" /> The [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] and [[Wikipedia:Game Boy Advance|Game Boy Advance]] versions of the game portray Kenobi arriving independently to the Temple, only meeting Yoda and planing to deactivate the beacon at its entrance. After fighting through clones Kenobi encounters a [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Jedi Temple)|clone trooper commander]] in the Jedi Archives and finds the bodies of several younglings there. In the game Kenobi and Yoda do not go to the beacon control room or find footage of Skywalker's betrayal, instead making their counterattack plans in the Archives after discovering dead Jedi.<ref name="Rots game portable" />

The infiltration is [[Canon|non-canonically]] featured in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|''The Complete Saga'']] compilation in the fifth level based on ''Revenge of the Sith'': "Ruin of the Jedi." The opening cutscene shows Yoda at the Temple entrance already waiting for Kenobi, who is shocked at the devastation of the Temple and relieved to see the old Master's survival. Kenobi also goes to approach several other robed figures but Yoda holds him back, as they are actually disguised clone troopers. As the level starts the player controls the two Jedi and has to fight through hordes of clone troopers to get inside the temple, also fighting inside the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]] and the Jedi Archives. The security hologram found by the Jedi shows Anakin killing [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]],<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]''</ref> which occurred in a deleted scene from the film.<ref name="Rots" />
